LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_MaxEventPawns_Too: Baseline maximum pawns generated per event (1-100, default 30), including adults, children, Ratkin young and animals. Each event retains its minimum required population; a limit below that minimum is ignored. Fixed groups such as mothers with children are exempt.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_FedWanderDays_Too: Each Ratkin independently stays for a random 50%-150% of this duration after first eating their fill, then leaves the map. Zero means immediate departure; default 0.5 days. Requires leaving after eating to be enabled. Shelter, employment and story obligations retain their own deadlines.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_WaitWhenNoFood: Wait when no food is available
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_WaitWhenNoFood_To: Wait and periodically search when no reachable food is available, leaving after the waiting period. When disabled, leave immediately. Search the relief area first, then other colony food sources.
